about_the_game:
Fight for your life in a fog-drenched world where evolved zombies hunt relentlessly. This uncompromising survival experience throws you into a post-apocalyptic nightmare where every shadow hides a threat and every resource matters.

The dangers grow deadlier as you venture deeper into territories no survivor has conquered. Will you become the hunter, or remain the hunted in the deadly stillness of Silent Woods?

Fight for your life in a fog-drenched world where evolved zombies hunt relentlessly. This uncompromising survival experience throws you into a post-apocalyptic nightmare where every shadow hides a threat and every resource matters.

Evolved Enemies

Face off against zombies that hunt with terrifying intelligence. Fire-wielders ignite the forest around you, while others move with unnatural speed or absorb damage that would fell a normal foe. Each variant forces you to adapt or die.

Epic Boss Encounters

Massive, mutated abominations guard the most valuable resources. Study their patterns, exploit their weaknesses, and earn rewards that transform your survival chances. Every boss defeated is a milestone in your desperate journey.

Strategic Survival

Every bullet, bandage, and ration counts in a world of scarcity. Make hard choices about what to carry and what to leave behind as you venture deeper into danger.

Mechanical Allies

Deploy reconnaissance drones to scout ahead and salvage robots to gather resources from hazardous areas. Unlock and upgrade combat automatons that fight alongside you when the hordes become overwhelming.

Arsenal Evolution

From makeshift pipes to military-grade firearms, your weapons evolve with your journey. Craft specialized modifications that complement your combat style—whether you prefer silent takedowns or explosive confrontations.

Innovative Crafting

Transform ordinary items into tools of survival:

  • Create tripwire traps from everyday electronics

  • Modify standard weapons with flame-spewing attachments

  • Build portable healing stations for extended exploration

Living, Breathing World

Weather shifts unpredictably, light fades to dangerous darkness, and the toxic fog ebbs and flows—forcing constant adaptation. The environment itself becomes both enemy and ally in your struggle to survive.

Endless Challenge

There is no finish line—only the next day, the next threat, the next discovery. Push deeper into unexplored territories, uncover the dark secrets of Silent Woods, and see how long you can defy the odds.

Your Survival Journey

  • EXPLORE a vast open world filled with danger and opportunity

  • CRAFT tools and weapons from salvaged materials

  • FIGHT intelligently against enemies that adapt to your tactics

  • SURVIVE against all odds in a world that wants you dead

Will you succumb to the shadows, or rise to become the most feared predator in Silent Woods?

name: Silent Woods

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1030 with 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™i7 3770 3.4GHz or AMD equivalent or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1650 with 4 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Direct Sound compatible (must support DirectX® 9.0c or higher)

short_description: Silent Woods blends survival horror, open-world exploration, and a deep crafting system to create a heart-pounding experience. How long can you survive in a world where death lurks in every shadow?
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Ukrainian, Japanese, Latvian, Croatian, Scots, Finnish, Swedish
*languages with full audio support
